title: Untimely
summary: UNTI'MELY, adjective 1. Happening before the usual time; as untimely frost. 2. Happening before the natural time; premature; as untimely death; untimely fate. UNTI'MELY, adverb Before the natural time

inlines.v: UNTI'MELY, adjective 1. Happening before the usual time; as untimely frost. 2. Happening before the natural time; premature; as untimely death; untimely fate. UNTI'MELY, adverb Before the natural time. What is untimely done.
